findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized.
findings.comment: Inspectors observed an accumulation of soil build-up in the dish machine. PIC was made aware. PIC assured inspectors that the soil accumulation will be clean. Ensure that the accumulation is monitored, cleaned, and sanitized at a regular frequency.
findings.citation_text: 4-601.11(A) Equipment, Food-Contact Surfaces, Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, and Utensils. (A) EQUIPMENT FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES and UTENSILS shall be clean to sight and touch.

findings.title: Plumbing installed; proper backflow devices.
findings.comment:
The following plumbing repairs requirements were observed.
1. The left faucet on the triple sink was observed leaking. 
2. The faucet on the dump sink was observed leaking continuously.
PIC was made aware. PIC assured inspectors that the relevant repairs will be done. Ensure that the plumbings is in good repair according to the LAW.
findings.citation_text: 5-205.15(A) System Maintained in Good Repair. A plumbing system shall be: (A) Repaired according to LAW.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.comment:
The following were observed. 
1. An accumulation of grease build up was observed on the sides of the  fryers. 
2. The coving trim tile under the drink station was observed coming off the wall. 
3. Inspectors observed a hole in the trim edge of the door to the dry storage. 
Discussed with PIC. PIC assured inspectors that the areas mentioned will receive the relevant corrections. Ensure that these corrections are made to provide smooth and easily cleanable surfaces.
findings.citation_text: 6-101.11(A)(1) Surface Characteristics. (A) Except as specified in (B) of this section, materials for indoor floor, wall, and ceiling surfaces under conditions of normal use shall be: (1) SMOOTH, durable, and EASILY CLEANABLE for areas where FOOD ESTABLISHMENT operations are conducted.

findings.title: Hands clean and properly washed.
findings.comment: Employee was observed donning gloves without washing their hands while preparing food. Discussed with PIC and employee was educated about proper handwashing procedures. Ensure that hands are washed in between tasks before changing gloves at all times during food prep.
findings.citation_text: 2-301.14 When to Wash. FOOD EMPLOYEES shall clean their hands and exposed portions of their arms as specified under § 2-301.12 immediately before engaging in FOOD preparation including working with exposed FOOD, clean EQUIPMENT and UTENSILS, and unwrapped SINGLE-SERVICE and SINGLE-USE ARTICLES and: (A) After touching bare human body parts other than clean hands and clean, exposed portions of arms; (B) After using the toilet room; (C) After caring for or handling SERVICE ANIMALS or aquatic animals as specified in 2-403.11(B); (D) Except as specified in 2-401.11(B), after coughing, sneezing, using a handkerchief or disposable tissue, using TOBACCO PRODUCTS, eating, or drinking; (E) After handling soiled EQUIPMENT or UTENSILS; (F) During FOOD preparation, as often as necessary to remove soil and contamination and to prevent cross contamination when changing tasks; (G) When switching between working with raw FOOD and working with READY-TO-EAT FOOD; (H) Before donning gloves to initiate a task that involves working with FOOD; and (I) After engaging in other activities that contaminate the hands.

findings.title: Food in good condition, safe, and unadulterated.
findings.comment: Inspectors observed cheese sauce being stored in the original can after being opened. PIC was educated about potential botulism contamination and the storage of the cheese sauce was changed. Ensure that food items in cans are transfer to adequate storage to avoid potential contamination hazards.
findings.citation_text: 3-202.15 Package Integrity. FOOD packages shall be in good condition and protect the integrity of the contents so that the FOOD is not exposed to ADULTERATION or potential contaminants.

findings.title: Food separated and protected.
findings.comment: Inspectors observed raw chicken being stored over fish in the two compartment cooler at the far end of the kitchen by the dish machine area. Discussed with PIC and the storage order was corrected. Ensure that the adequate storage order for food items are practice efficiently.
findings.citation_text: 3-302.11(A)(2) Packaged and Unpackaged Food - Separation, Packaging, and Segregation. (A) FOOD shall be protected from cross contamination by: (2) Except when combined as ingredients, separating types of raw animal FOODS from each other such as beef, FISH, lamb, pork, and POULTRY during storage, preparation, holding, and display by: (a) Using separate EQUIPMENT for each type, or (b) Arranging each type of FOOD in EQUIPMENT so that cross contamination of one type with another is prevented, and (c) Preparing each type of FOOD at different times or in separate areas.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
6-501.16: Inspector observed mop to be stored on the ground by the dish machine and by the mop bucket. Hang mops sot hat they can dry. 

After use, mops shall be placed in a position that allows them to air dry without soiling walls, EQUIPMENT, or supplies.

findings.title: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used
findings.comment:
Inspector observed shelf liner on shelf behind hot holding to be absorbent and not cleanable. Replace liner with a material that is consistent with the following section of the code. 

4-101.19: NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT that are exposed to splash, spillage, or other FOOD soiling or that require frequent cleaning shall be constructed of a CORROSION-RESISTANT, nonabsorbent, and SMOOTH material.
